objective: Create a reproducible repository, architecture and approved-experience guardrails, validation system, and machine-readable backlog that make small AI-authored changes safe and reviewable.

qualificationRemediation.trigger: The first capability-wide security-local run correctly blocked lxml 6.0.2 for CVE-2026-41066 and the scanner's unknown classification of greenlet's MIT AND PSF-2.0 declaration.
resolution: The frozen direct dependency was upgraded to stable lxml 6.1.1, above the advisory's fixed boundary of 6.1.0.

SPDX AND expressions are accepted only when every component is already individually allowlisted; a denied, unlisted, OR, WITH, or malformed expression remains blocked or follows the existing fail-closed category policy.
No vulnerability or license exception was added and no release threshold was weakened.

At the same exact clean commit, all 23 commands passed in 392.77 seconds: 143 foundation tests, 15 desktop tests, 32 routes, 14 workflows, 521 region contracts, 139 browser cases, 390 keyboard cases, 64 responsive visuals, and 64 pinned Windows captures.

crossCuttingQualification.happyPath: Fresh-checkout bootstrap evidence, deterministic benchmarks/build identity, complete task lifecycle, approved offline UI reference, and foundation/security/desktop profiles pass.
crossCuttingQualification.failureAndDenial: Missing tools, frozen-install failure, dependency/profile/gate mismatch, unauthorized owner/reviewer, stale evidence, malformed history, path redirects, network UI surfaces, self-approval, scanner violations, and conformance drift reject actionably.
crossCuttingQualification.cancellation: Campaign cancellation is explicit, ownership-bound, and regression-tested together with start, pause/resume, and release-gate escape denial.
crossCuttingQualification.migrationAndCompatibility: No product database exists before CAP-01. Repository schema compatibility is governed through strict backlog, evidence, ADR, baseline, benchmark, version, and manifest history validation; repaired invalid history cannot be laundered.
crossCuttingQualification.restartAndRecovery: Bootstrap is idempotent, task/campaign leases renew or resume under exact ownership, failed installs publish no configuration, and atomic ledger/build writes preserve the prior destination on replace failure, tamper, race, or stale writer.
crossCuttingQualification.securityPrivacyRights: Pinned Trivy installation and controlled configuration scan source and installed dependencies with zero blockers; raw secret material is never retained; fixtures are synthetic CC0-1.0; browser checks abort network access; private or production data is absent.
crossCuttingQualification.accessibility: All 32 product pages pass exact required-region, keyboard/focus, light/dark, and two-viewport responsive accessibility contracts with deterministic browser evidence.
crossCuttingQualification.platform: Windows x64 is the release-authoritative W0 platform and passes exact runtime/bootstrap and pinned Chromium/Playwright/font/viewport qualification. Server, cloud, and non-Windows release profiles remain correctly gated.
crossCuttingQualification.backupRestore: There is no application data before CAP-01. Repository authority is Git-versioned, generated views are reproducible, and every mutable control-plane/output publication path exercised here is atomic and recovery-tested.

releaseGateG0.evidence: Fresh-checkout bootstrap evidence plus current foundation/build/package checks pass.
The complete ledger, capability campaign, six independent slice reviews, task transitions, cancellation/resume, and release-gate invariants validate automatically.
Architecture rules and the Accepted ADR lifecycle are documented, indexed, protected, and machine checked.
The approved reference, workflow catalog, page contracts, design-first gate, and full Windows conformance profile are installed and passing.

residualLimitations: Hosted CI execution itself is not available locally; its pinned workflow, least-privilege permissions, commands, and evidence retention contract are validated locally.

Server, cloud, non-Windows desktop, university administration, product data migration, and application backup/restore remain correctly assigned to later release-gated capabilities.
